answer_1.quote: We propose 'Taxonomy Free Character Role Labeling' (TF-CRL): an open-ended narrative understanding task that assigns a short noun phrase to the function a character performs in a narrative.

answer_4.quote: Workers from Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) were shown the full article, a target character, and the candidate labels... Workers were asked to rank them from best to worst and rate each label according to the criteria in Table 2.
answer_4.guideline: Workers ranked labels and rated them according to faithfulness (binary yes/no), relevance (3-point Likert), informativeness (3-point), and generalizability (3-point)
